rules.question: Is the functional specification or requirement available?
Does the model know the diff or the precise set of files to analyze?
Are the relevant language, framework, and versions known?
Have all callers of the modified code been identified?
rules.applies_if: Code modifies existing signatures or contracts

rules.question: Have all public or external boundaries been identified?
rules.applies_if: Code exposes or consumes external interfaces

rules.question: Is the rule applicable to the analyzed code?
Have relevant deterministic checks been executed?
rules.applies_if: Automated project tooling exists (linter, type-check, scanner)

rules.question: Can every finding be anchored to a precise location?
Is uncertainty distinguished from a positive verification?
Does the rule verify a single independent issue?
